EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (A) - PROVINCIAL COUNCILS
UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Governor for Uva Provincial Council

BY virtue of powers vested to me by Section 32(1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, I, M. P. Jayasinghe,Governor of Uva Province do hereby notify that the following appointments have been approved by me.
1) Mr. G. K. S. L. Rajadasa, Class I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Chief Secretary of

Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post, from the date 20.01.2017 till the return to the Island of Mr.Gamini Rajakaruna, Chief Secretary of Uva Province, who is abroad from the date 21.01.2017 to 01.02.2017.
2) Mr. G. K. S. L. Rajadasa, Class I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform the duties of the

Secretary to the Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs, Tourism, Transport, Cultural Affairs and Textile and SmallIndustries of Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post, from the date 14.01.2017 till the return to theIsland of Mr. W. M. M. G. Abeysinghe Banda, the Secretary to the Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs, Tourism,Transport, Cultural Affairs and Textile and Small Industries of Uva Province, who is abroad from the date 14.01.2017to 13.02.2017.
3) Dr. Mrs. M. K. D. Senanayake, Retired Special Grade officer of the Senior Medical Administrative Service, has
been re-appointed on contract basis as Director to the Health Service of Uva Province, from the date 10.01.2017till the appointment of a permanent officer or up to 30.06.2017
4) Mr. S. K. Weerasundara, Class I Officer of the Sri Lanka Animal Product and Health Service, as Acting Provincial
Director at the Department of Animal Product and Health of Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post,with effect from the date 21.02.2017.
5) Mrs. D. M. Vineetha Dissanayake, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform the duties of

the Secretary to the Ministry of Finance and Planning, Law and Peace, Education, Local Government, Power andEnergy, Construction, Rural Infrastructure Facilities and Land of Uva Province, in addition to her pemanent post,from the date 27.02.2017, till the return to the Island of Mr. G. A. M. S. P. Ambanwela, the Secretary to the Ministryof Finance and Planning, Law and Peace, Education, Local Government, Power and Energy, Construction, RuralInfrastructure Facilities and Land of Uva Province, who is abroad from the date 27.02.2017 to 11.03.2017.

6) Mr. D. M. Rathnayake, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Educational Administrative Service, to perform the

duties of the Provincial Director to Education of Uva, in addition to his permanent post, from the date 27.02.2017,till the return to the Island of Mr. R. M. P. Rathnayake, the Provincial Director to Education of Uva, who isabroad from the date 27.02.2017 to 12.03.2017.
7) Mr. S. B. Udovita, Class I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Municipal Commissioner of
Badulla Municipal Council with immediate effect from the date 07.04.2017.
8) Mr. W. Randeniya, Class III officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Secretary to the Co-
operative Employees Commission of Uva Province, on full time basis with immediate effect from the day07.04.2017.
9) Mr. Gunadasa Samarasinghe, Special Grade officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, As Secretary to the
Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation, Animal Production, Inland Fisheries Industry of Uva Province, with effect fromthe date 01.07.2016.
